evidence: Replaces static headers presync parameters with runtime optimization in src/headerssync.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp to improve DoS resistance.
rationale: Dynamically computing commitment period and redownload buffer sizes prevents memory bound inflation (up to 50x after clock corrections) and fixes a theoretical attack-model oversight. Calculating optimal parameters at runtime eliminates recurring maintainer release toil while tightening headers-presync resource accounting against malicious peers.
